sources: Historical MIT SkillCorner first-division data and CC BY4.0 Sportec/IDSSE first-division data; existing local files only
features: 508joint features, rawfloat32 memory-mapped arrays; no team/spatial swap duplication. Labels stored separately.
weak_supervision: Known H/A only, unknown stays-1; known-frame weight.5; no weak dead labels or boundary targets.
strong_supervision: Known live H/A only with032spell weights; narrow+-2event target and fully known-live+-12valid neighbourhood. Dead/unknown excluded from neural control loss.
seeds: Existing fixed training-condition seeds; no validation conditions/features included.
